cohort: Pregnant women presenting for post-partum tubal ligation
finding: A standardized protocol for post-partum salpingectomy using suture ligation is feasible and safe
mod_finding: Post-partum salpingectomy performed after vaginal delivery resulted in slightly longer operative times and slightly greater blood loss than modified Pomeroy tubal ligation; post-partum salpingectomy at cesarean resulted in no difference in estimated blood loss, but slightly longer operative times compared to Parkland tubal ligations.
